propositions: Add `rebar review-plan --retry` CLI flag that resumes only the latest eligible INDETERMINATE review by reusing checkpointed success/resumed units and re-running failed/cancelled/shed units under a fresh attempt budget.

Retry eligibility requires a versioned discovery_journal in the latest REVIEW_RESULT sidecar with verdict INDETERMINATE and at least one retryable unit; refuse with exit code 2 before any model call if journal is missing, stale, legacy, corrupt, or digest-mismatched.

Reconstruct checkpoint_identity/identity_digest from current ticket material, code/ref, effective policy, prompts, model/mode, topology, context, dependencies, and source; load matching CheckpointEnvelope and reuse findings only if digest matches and envelope exists, else treat as missing and re-run.

Reusable units (success/resumed kinds) contribute clean and blocking findings to combined result; budget-shed units enumerated from budget_indeterminate findings are re-attempted as missing; Pass-2 verification/coaching and deterministic decision/assembly run only over newly recovered work.

Make `--retry` mutually exclusive with `--force`, `--status`, and `--check`; keep compatible with `--no-sign`; document in review-plan --help, CLI reference, user guide, plan-review gate guide, and exit-codes.md.

Test with real CLI subprocess, production journal codec, and stateful fake at model boundary; assert exit code, stdout/stderr contract, exact called unit ids, persisted lineage, final verdict, and zero calls on negative/fault cases.
